description_en: Supports structured output of six key fields—name, certificate number, sampling date, sampling time, testing organization, and test result—from COVID-19 Testing Station records with varying formats across different regions nationwide
description_zh: 支持对全国各地区不同版式的核酸检测记录中姓名、证件号码、采样日期、采样时间、检测机构、检测结果等6个关键字段的结构化结果输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-covid-test-report --url http://duguang-database-public.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/covid_init_covid_test_report/test_report_data_pool_15a4f85478cb1bd69a5d631b182aba69.jpg_item_0_cls_covid_test_report.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --multiple-result false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCovidTestReport

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return multiple classification results when an image contains multiple subgraphs. By default, this is not required.  
true: Returns classification results for all subgraphs; false: Returns only the result with the latest detection date.
parameters.help_zh:
当一张图有多个子图时，是否要返回多个识别结果,默认不需要。
true：返回所有子图识别结果；false：返回检测日期最新的一个结果
parameters.name: multiple_result

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
